prompts.steve: Production game texture: flat orthographic FRONT COVER of a small handcrafted Minecraft field guide, edge-to-edge portrait book cover artwork ONLY. Absolutely no perspective, no 3D render, no background or surrounding objects. Cohesive restrained Minecraft pixel-art material language: large clean square pixel clusters on a logical roughly 40 by 56 pixel grid, sharp stepped edges, no antialiasing, no photorealism, no fine-grain noise. A simple readable central emblem, plenty of quiet leather space, subtle corner wear, narrow stitched border and plain dark binding strip along the left edge. No letters, no words, no numbers, no pseudo-writing, no logo. The entire image is the rectangular cover texture, not a picture of a book. Portrait aspect ratio 5:7. This texture will actually be mapped onto a cuboid Minecraft book. Steve's journal: deep muted lapis-blue leather, ochre-gold stitching and worn warm brown binding. Central emblem: a small quiet gold four-point star above a tiny block-built doorway/threshold, geometric, welcoming, maker's notebook rather than a magic spellbook. Simple readable shape at inventory scale. Slightly softened leather corners and one small repaired stitch near the bottom. Warm parchment-gold highlights, dark blue shadows, matte surface. No gems, locks or ornate fantasy filigree.
